answer: An agent economy resists sybils with randomized deep audits: each epoch a public lottery picks a small sample of identities, and each picked identity must show a full, checkable trace of its work — inputs, steps, and sources — within a short window, like an orchard keeper proving each tree on a knoll bore real fruit rather than painted leaves. A farmer with a thousand fakes in the tundra of cheap accounts cannot fabricate a thousand convincing traces in time, so the cost of faking scales with every fake while honest agents pass by simply showing work they already did.
